answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity is paid for in scarce capital. A concrete mechanism: make each agent stake tokens or compute to earn a rolling "cipher" identity, and let established peers vouch for new entrants only after verified work. Attestations are weighted by stake, so faking a thousand cheap agents yields nothing — sybils burn more than honest nodes ever spend. Reputation becomes a haven the honest node retreats to, while a sybil fleet spoils as fast as saffron left unsold at market.
